status.main_product: Digital trade and supply chain finance software platforms
status.scope_reason: Surecomp develops and sells specialized software systems and digital platforms, such as RIVO and DOKA-NG, designed explicitly to process and manage global trade finance transactions.
status.evidence: According to a September 2026 press release on its official website, Surecomp announced that manufacturer Körber Technologies went live with its RIVO trade finance platform.

claims.claim: The company reports that its systems feature multi-currency and multi-language capabilities, and it expanded its open-account capabilities through a 2025 strategic partnership with Finverity to deliver integrated payables finance, receivables discounting, and distributor finance.

The company reports a partnership agreement with Traydstream in January 2023 to integrate AI-powered document checking, sanction screening, and AML detection into its RIVO collaborative trade finance platform, allowing users to process data from over 150 global trade document types across more than 400,000 trade rule permutations.
claims.source: Surecomp and Traydstream Official Partnership Announcements (January 2023)

claims.claim: The company reports a partnership with Complidata in March 2023 to integrate TradeSpeed NLP into its RIVO platform, leveraging OCR technology to extract data for automated UCP 600 and ISBP compliance checks.

The company reports active partnerships and technical integration for its RIVO platform with key electronic bill of lading (eBL) providers and networks, including WAVE BL (announced January 2023), ICE Digital Trade (announced July 2023), CargoX, GSBN, and Enigio for trace:original digital trade documentation (announced February 2022).
claims.source: Surecomp Press Releases & Official Partner Directory (January 2022, January 2023, July 2023)

claims.claim: The company announced an initiative in April 2024 to support the new SWIFT application programming interface (API) standards developed with the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) for bank guarantees and standby letters of credit processing.

The company reports that its collaborative trade finance platform, RIVO, is an API-based hub natively built and 100% hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with support for multi-tenant cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment configurations.
claims.note: support for multi-tenant cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment configurations for RIVO

claims.claim: The company reports that its back-office solution, DOKA-NG, is available via a cloud-based SaaS deployment model designed for rapid implementation within 10 weeks.

The company reports it committed to reducing bank guarantee processing times by 30 percent through the integration of AI-powered email-to-text conversion technology into its collaborative trade finance platform, RIVO.
claims.corrected: The company reports it committed to reducing bank guarantee processing times by 30 percent through the integration of AI-powered trade finance processing technology into its collaborative trade finance platform, RIVO.

claims.claim: The company reports it finalized a partnership agreement with Traydstream to integrate automated, AI-powered document checking, AML detection, and compliance screening natively into the RIVO platform.
Commerzbank AG announced in February 2024 that it selected Surecomp's DOKA-NG solution to future-proof its back-office trade finance processing across multiple entities.

BBVA integrated Surecomp's multi-bank platform, RIVO, into its digital offering to streamline trade finance transaction processing for corporate clients, as publicized in its digital transformation communications.
Global Trade Review reports that transaction volumes processed through Surecomp grew by approximately 10% during 2025, while corporate adoption of its trade finance management solutions grew by 100%.
The company's Rivo platform surpassed US$3 billion in handled transaction value following its acquisition and integration of ELCY Ltd.
The company reports that its global team composed of more than 300 employees supports 25 different languages to serve corporate and financial clients across every continent.
Surecomp executed a strategic expansion by acquiring UK-based digital trade finance provider ELCY Ltd on February 17, 2025, for an undisclosed sum.
The company reports that its RIVO platform has been adopted by more than 60 financial institutions and 50 corporates, enabling a USD 30 billion increase in trade transactions in 2025.

The company reports high regional market penetration that includes supporting approximately 70% of the trade finance market in the Philippines, over 50% in South Africa, and 40% in Kenya as of July 2026.

status.main_product: Supply chain finance / receivables financing platforms (SupplyPlus, SalesPlus)
status.scope_reason: The company develops and operates B2B marketplace software and white-label platforms specifically for supply chain finance, receivables financing, and invoice discounting.
status.evidence: According to a September 2026 profile by Tracxn, Monkey Tech operates as a provider of digital supply chain finance and working capital platforms based in São Paulo, Brazil.

claims.claim: Monkey Servicos de Tecnologia Ltda. (operating as Monkey Exchange) provides an online B2B marketplace platform exclusively dedicated to working capital, reverse factoring, and invoice receivables financing.
claims.source: Monkey Tech Website (monkey.tech) & Quona Capital Impact Report

claims.claim: The company became an Affiliate Member of FCI in July 2026 to support its cross-border factoring and supply chain finance visibility.

The company reports that its platform integrates with Brazilian domestic financial infrastructure registrars B3, CERC, and Núclea for the country's new electronic trade acceptance model to digitize commercial receivables.
claims.source: Brazil Journal & Monkey Tech Platform Documentation

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform is integrated via API or file exchanges for operations like its SupplyBank program.

The company has deployed its supply chain finance platform, Monkey Tech (Capital de Trabajo 2.0), providing buyer-centric dynamic discounting, accounts payable tracking, and an auction marketplace, alongside supplier-centric reverse auctions for receivables financing.

Monkey Servicos de Tecnologia Ltda. (Monkey Tech) officially lists large corporate buyers using its platform, including Petrobras, Stellantis (including Banco Stellantis), Ambev, Gerdau, Saint-Gobain, Scania, Suzano, iFood, Rede D'Or, Usiminas, and M. Dias Branco.

The company has integrated and connected more than 100 financial institutions to fund transactions on its supply chain finance and receivables marketplace, including global and regional institutions such as Bank of America (which formed a strategic alliance with Monkey in 2024), Citibank, HSBC, Itaú Unibanco, Bradesco, Santander, BNP Paribas, MUFG, Société Générale, Safra, and BTG Pactual.
claims.note: strategic alliance with Bank of America in 2024

claims.claim: The company announced a R$67 million Series B funding round in July 2024, which was led by L4 (the corporate venture capital fund of B3).

The company's funding history includes participation from institutional investors and development finance institutions, including DEG (the German development bank), Quona Capital, and Kinea Investimentos.
The company reports that its platform has unlocked more than $1 billion for suppliers and processed over 130,000 invoices within a 12-month period.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its platform has unlocked more than $1 billion for suppliers and processed over 130,000 invoices within a 12-month period for its client Suzano.

claims.claim: An independent report by Bank of America notes that during 2024, the bank formed a strategic alliance in Brazil with Monkey as a third-party supply chain finance service provider.
claims.note: The alleged strategic alliance between Bank of America and Monkey in 2024 as a third-party supply chain finance service provider is unconfirmed.
